_comment: The draft pharmacy crosswalk tabs are sourced from this versioned repo file (design: Operations/research/crosswalk-pipeline/crosswalk-pipeline-design.md). scripts/generateCrosswalk.js reads these 2D-array rows (header + data rows, same shape parseCSV yields for Sheet tabs) and renders them into the AUTO-GENERATED block of crosswalk.mdx. Each carrier column is read from its example file in benefit-plan-schema/examples/; the Aetna column uses aetna_example.json. Pharmacy Tiers name is the raw_label of each pharmacy tier benefit. Coverage Stages come from $.pharmacy.coverage_stages, which only the two Summary of Benefits examples carry. "not in example" marks a value the example file does not carry. tier_code values in the Pharmacy Tier Codes reference table are canonical FHIR DrugTierVS. Drug-level formulary data is intentionally absent (its source is formulary files, not plan summaries).
